title: [GMCP 203.025.M] Mastery: OAuth-protected MCP resource server
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-025-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Remote GMCP endpoints implement current MCP authorization and OAuth resource-server requirements: protected-resource metadata, authorization-server discovery, issuer and audience validation, scopes, challenges, PKCE-facing metadata, token expiry/revocation and TLS. Token passthrough is impossible, resource and authorization roles remain separated, and confused-deputy, mix-up, replay and malformed-token suites fail closed. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
